methodology: Manual approximate 300dpi figure read with generous point-sensitivity bands; no author original numbers, no patient data.
comparability_cautions: Figure 1 time-zero concentration unplotted, modeled as hypothetical 0-50 pg/mL for sensitivity only.
Figure y axis is broken; error bars are marginal SD, not individual samples or a CI on area.
Published individual subject AUCs are predose-baseline-subtracted; reconstruction of group mean concentration from figure is not directly the same statistical estimand.
Numerically integrating participant-level AUC and averaging is linear if identical time weights and missingness; differences need provenance.
Neither manual nor Wikimedia points are a new blind cohort or authorized raw subject data.
